exclude.description: Extra globs to exclude. Entries are APPENDED to the default shown here rather than replacing it, so deleting one of the defaults from your own list changes nothing — negate it instead ("!**/vendor/**", or "!**" for all of them).

base.description: The branch, tag or commit changes are compared with wherever a run names none: the viewer's Changes page, and `lint --since` / `impact --since` given no ref. Without it the base is guessed — the branch origin/HEAD names, then main, then master — which is wrong wherever work starts from another branch. Write a remote-tracking name such as "origin/develop" so every clone has it.
